Application Data.NAME: Sunny Gifts & Souvenirs
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Sunny Gifts & Souvenirs is a retail store located in the heart of Orlando, FL, specializing in a variety of gift items and souvenirs for tourists and locals alike. With over three years of successful operation, we pride ourselves on our well-curated selection of merchandise that reflects the vibrant culture of our city. Our shop features high-quality products, including locally made crafts, unique home decor, and Florida-themed memorabilia. We maintain strict inventory controls and have implemented robust security measures, including a CCTV system and regular employee training on loss prevention. Our friendly staff is dedicated to providing excellent customer service, ensuring a welcoming shopping experience for all visitors. Additionally, we offer a small online shopping platform, while actively managing our cybersecurity risks to protect our customers' data.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 06/15/2023, our store experienced a theft incident involving approximately $1,500 worth of inventory, primarily small souvenirs and gift items. The loss was reported to local authorities, and the claim is currently under review with the insurance company. As of now, the status of the claim is pending.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: CCTV surveillance system with 24/7 monitoring, on-site security personnel during peak hours, and secure storage for high-value items.
